test_TestDeprecatedCwdWarning: test the TestDeprecatedCwdWarning class that warns when MESSAGING_CWD or TERMINAL_CWD env vars are set in .env
test_messaging_cwd_triggers_warning: test that warn_deprecated_cwd_env_vars emits a warning when MESSAGING_CWD is set and config is empty
test_terminal_cwd_triggers_warning_when_: test that warn_deprecated_cwd_env_vars warns when TERMINAL_CWD is set with a placeholder cwd in config
test_no_warning_when_config_has_explicit: test that warn_deprecated_cwd_env_vars suppresses warning when TERMINAL_CWD matches explicit cwd in config
test_no_warning_when_env_clean: test that warn_deprecated_cwd_env_vars produces no warning when deprecated env vars are unset
